svg.title: Make the first request cheaper; keep the cap
svg.desc: Before: auto routing to Claude Sonnet 5.5, repository-wide instructions, and broad GitHub MCP toolsets. After: GPT-5.6 Luna pinned, bare mode with explicit safety rules, and gh-proxy limited to the context and issues toolsets. Instead of raising the caps, the 5- and 8-credit caps stay unchanged. The change still needs a live run to confirm cost and output quality.

g.text: Still to verify in a live run:
within the cap, and output stays accurate + safe
